y-m-58-07.title: Idatha efanayo, igrafu enomuzwa ohlukile
y-m-58-07.topic: Ukubonisa idatha: idatha efanayo, amagrafu ahlukile
y-m-58-07.goal: Qonda ukuthi inani lokuqala nebanga le-axis ebheke phezulu kwenza idatha efanayo ibukeke ngokuhlukile, thola futhi ulungise ukuhumusha okweqile, bese ukhetha isikali esifanelana nesimo wena.
y-m-58-07.material: Ukuthengisa kwenyanga kwesitolo (izinto) kungu-200 kuJanuwari, 204 kuFebhuwari, 208 kuMashi no-212 ku-Ephreli (idatha ebumbiwe). Isihloko A sethulwe igrafu yomugqa ene-axis ebheke phezulu edwetshwe kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-250, futhi isihloko B sethulwe igrafu yomugqa ene-axis ebheke phezulu edwetshwe kusuka ku-198 kuya ku-214. Amaphoyinti kwamagrafu womabili yidatha efanayo. Umugqa kugrafu B ubukeka sengathi unyuka ngokuqondile.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izitatimende eziyiqiniso ngamagrafu amabili.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.hint.0: Funda inani lephoyinti likaJanuwari nenani lephoyinti lika-Ephreli kwigrafu ngayinye yamabili bese uziqhathanisa.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi iqiniso lokuthi amabanga ama-axis abheke phezulu ahlukile lithinta kanjani isimo se-slope somugqa.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.o.a: Igrafu B ibukeka inyuka kakhulu, ngakho ukuthengisa kwangempela kukhule ngokushesha kuyi-B
y-m-58-07.s.s1.o.b: Ukushintsha ukuqala nesikali sesikhala se-axis ebheke phezulu kungaveza umuzwa ohlukile noma ngedatha efanayo
y-m-58-07.s.s1.r.b: Uyazi ukuthi indlela idatha ebonisiwe ngayo ingashintsha umuzwa, noma ngedatha efanayo.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.o.c: Igrafu B, ene-axis ebheke phezulu engaqali ku-0, igrafu yamanga edweba amanani edatha ngokuhlukile
y-m-58-07.s.s1.r.c: Amaphoyinti ka-B nawo abonisa amanani afanayo nedatha yangempela. Inkinga akuyona amanani kodwa umuzwa odalwa yisikali.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.o.d: Ukuthengisa okubonakala emaphoyinteni amagrafu amabili kuyalingana komunye nomunye
y-m-58-07.s.s1.r.d: Lokhu ukukhetha okuqinisekisa ukuthi idatha efanayo yadwetshwa ngezikali ezihlukile.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.explain: Amagrafu amabili adweba nje idatha efanayo nge-axes ezibheke phezulu ezihlukile. Ukushintsha i-axis kungenza umugqa ubukeke unyuka kakhulu, kodwa ukuthengisa ngokwakho kuyafana. I-axis eqala ku-0 nayo ayihlali ingcono kakhulu (isibonelo, kudatha lapho izinguquko ezincane kudingeka zibonisiwe).
y-m-58-07.s.s2.prompt: Khetha umugqa ongalungile encazelweni yeporter B yesihloko.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.hint.0: Funda ukuthi yiliphi inani elihambisana nokuphakama 0 kugrafu B.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.hint.1: Thola wena isilinganiso sokuthengisa kuJanuwari no-Ephreli.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.line.0: Ukuthengisa kwanda ngezinto ezingu-4 inyanga ngayinye: 200, 204, 208, 212.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.line.1: Kusuka kuJanuwari kuya ku-Ephreli kwanda ngo-12, ngakho kwanda ngamaphesenti angu-6 enani lokuqala.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.line.2: Kugrafu B, iphoyinti lika-Ephreli liphezulu ngezikhathi ezingu-7 kunephoyinti likaJanuwari, ngakho ukuthengisa kwaba izikhathi ezingu-7 ezinkulu.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.line.3: Ngakho kungabhalwa ukuthi lesi sitolo sikhula ngokushesha kakhulu.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.explain: Umugqa 3 ungephutha. I-axis ebheke phezulu yegrafu B iqala ku-198, ngakho ukuphakama kwephoyinti kubonisa kuphela umehluko kusuka ku-198 (2 no-14). Ukuthengisa ngokwakho kunyuke kusuka ku-200 kuya ku-212, okungamaphesenti angu-6 hhayi izikhathi ezingu-7. Umugqa 4 isiphetho esincike kuleli phutha.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.prompt: Manje ufuna ukudweba igrafu yesihloko C ngokunemba. Nquma umphetho ongezansi y0 nomphetho ongaphezulu y1 we-axis ebheke phezulu (zombili izikhathi zika-10, y0 ingu-200 ubuningi, y1 ingu-212 okungenani) ukuze ukwanda okungu-12 kusuka kuJanuwari kuya ku-Ephreli kubonakale njengo-10% noma ngaphansi kobude bonke be-axis ebheke phezulu. Ukuze isikali singabi banzi kakhulu, y1−y0 ingu-400 ubuningi. Faka ama-(y0, y1) ama-2 ahlukene.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ngesibalo ukuthi ukwanda okungu-12 kungamaphesenti amangaki obude bonke be-axis ebheke phezulu.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi i-axis kumele ibe yinde okungenani kangakanani ukuze lowo mkhawulo ube ngu-10% noma ngaphansi.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.fail.c1: y0 no-y1 kumele zibe yizikhathi zika-10.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.ok.c2: Idatha engu-200 kuya ku-212 ifaneleka ngaphakathi kwe-axis.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.fail.c2: Idatha engu-200 kuya ku-212 kumele yonke ifaneleke ngaphakathi kwe-axis.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.ok.c3: Ukwanda okungu-12 kungu-10% noma ngaphansi kobude be-axis.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.fail.c3: Ubude be-axis bufushane, ngakho u-12 ubukeka mkhulu kuno-10%.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.explain: Uma ubude be-axis bungu-120 noma ngaphezulu, u-12 ubukeka njengo-10% noma ngaphansi. Izibonelo: 0 kuya ku-250 (ubude 250) no-100 kuya ku-300 (ubude 200) zombili ziyenzeka. I-axis akudingeki iqale ku-0; ubude kumele bube banele nje.
